title: The Community Garden Project
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，回答10个问题。文章和题目均为模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思试题。请根据文章内容选择或填写答案。填空题答案必须与原文完全一致，且不超过字数限制。
passage:
Last year, the local council in the town of Greenfield decided to turn an empty piece of land into a community garden. The land was behind the library and had been unused for many years. The council wanted to make the area more attractive, so they invited residents to join a planning meeting. Many people came, and they had different ideas about what to do.

Some people wanted to grow vegetables because they thought it would be healthy and cheap. Others wanted flowers to make the town look prettier. A few people were worried about the cost. They said the council might not have enough money to maintain the garden. However, the council explained that volunteers would do most of the work, so the cost would be low. In the end, the group agreed to have both vegetables and flowers.

The garden opened in spring. People from the neighbourhood signed up to take care of small plots. Mrs. Chen, a retired teacher, took a plot and grew tomatoes and beans. She said, "I can share the vegetables with my neighbours, so we can all eat fresh food." Her neighbour, Mr. Patel, grew sunflowers because he wanted to attract bees. He believes that bees are important for the environment.

Not everything went smoothly. In summer, there was a long dry period, and the plants needed a lot of water. The council could not provide extra water because of a shortage. The volunteers had to collect rainwater in barrels. Some people complained that the garden was too much work. But most volunteers enjoyed the project. They said it was a good way to meet people and get exercise.

At the end of the year, the council asked for feedback. Many residents said the garden had made the area friendlier. Some suggested adding a small playground for children. The council is now considering this idea. They might build the playground next year if they can find the money. For now, the garden continues to bring people together.

One volunteer, Sarah, said, "I might not have a big garden at home, but I can come here and grow my own herbs. It's very satisfying." Another volunteer, Tom, added, "We may not always agree on everything, but we all want the garden to succeed." The project shows that when people work together, they can create something valuable.

In autumn, the council organised a harvest festival to celebrate the garden's first year. Residents brought dishes made from the vegetables and flowers they had grown. Mrs. Chen made a tomato soup that everyone loved. Mr. Patel displayed a large sunflower in the centre of the table. The festival was a great success, and it helped to strengthen the friendship among neighbours. The council plans to make the festival an annual event. They hope it will encourage more people to join the garden project. Sarah said, "I never thought I would enjoy gardening so much. It's a wonderful way to relax and meet new people." Tom agreed, "We may have different opinions, but we all share the same goal: to make our community a better place." The garden has not only provided fresh produce but also created a sense of belonging. The council is now thinking about starting similar projects in other parts of the town. They believe that with enough volunteers, these projects can be successful. However, they also know that they might face challenges such as water shortages or lack of interest. But they are optimistic because the community has shown great support. In the future, they may apply for a government grant to expand the garden. For now, the community garden stands as a symbol of what can be achieved when people work together.

grammar.title: 原因、结果与让步从句；may / might / can 的语气差别
grammar.explanation: 英语中，原因从句常用 because, since, as 引导；结果从句常用 so (that) 引导；让步从句常用 although, though, even though 引导。情态动词 may 表示可能性（较正式），might 表示可能性较小或不确定，can 表示能力或允许。例如：'Some people wanted to grow vegetables because they thought it would be healthy and cheap.'（原因）'The council wanted to make the area more attractive, so they invited residents to join a planning meeting.'（结果）'They might build the playground next year if they can find the money.'（might 表示不确定的可能性）
grammar.example: Some people wanted to grow vegetables because they thought it would be healthy and cheap.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: The council invited residents ______ they wanted to hear their ideas.
questions.explanation: 这里需要表示原因，所以用 because。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: The garden was a lot of work, ______ most volunteers enjoyed it.
questions.explanation: 这里表示让步，所以用 although。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: The plants needed water, ______ the volunteers collected rainwater.
questions.explanation: 这里表示结果，所以用 so。

questions.prompt: Which sentence shows the smallest possibility?
options: They may build the playground next year.
They might build the playground next year.
They can build the playground next year.
They will build the playground next year.
answers: They might build the playground next year.
questions.explanation: might 表示的可能性比 may 更小，can 表示能力或允许，will 表示肯定。
